name: Conditional Probability
description: Update a probability when you learn something. Build to Bayes’ rule and use it on trades.

skills.cond-mult: Multiplication rule, trees and total probability

lessonNames.l1-what-changes: What changes when you learn something
lessonNames.l21-tuesday-boy: The boy born on a Tuesday

lessonObjectives.l1-what-changes: See that new information can change a probability, and notice when it does not.
lessonObjectives.l2-counting-left: Find a conditional probability by counting the outcomes that are still possible.
lessonObjectives.l3-shrinking: Compute $P(A \mid B)$ as a count inside $B$, not inside everything.
lessonObjectives.l4-multiplication-rule: Find $P(A \cap B)$ as $P(A)\,P(B \mid A)$ for draws in sequence.
lessonObjectives.l5-trees: Draw a probability tree and multiply along its branches.
lessonObjectives.l6-adding-branches: Find a probability by adding every path that leads to it: the law of total probability.
lessonObjectives.l7-turning-around: Find $P(B \mid A)$ from $P(A \mid B)$, and see that the two differ.
lessonObjectives.l8-base-rates: See how a rare condition makes most positive tests false.
lessonObjectives.l9-natural-frequencies: Solve a Bayes problem by imagining 1,000 cases.
lessonObjectives.l10-odds-form: Update odds by multiplying by the likelihood ratio.
lessonObjectives.l11-updating-twice: Chain two updates, using the first posterior as the next prior.
lessonObjectives.l12-many-hypotheses: Apply Bayes’ rule across several competing explanations at once.
lessonObjectives.l13-knowing-nothing: Define independence as $P(A \mid B) = P(A)$ and test for it.
lessonObjectives.l14-independent-trials: Multiply probabilities across independent repeated trials.
lessonObjectives.l15-pairwise: Find three events that are independent in pairs but not all together.
lessonObjectives.l16-conditional-independence: Separate independence from independence given a third event.
lessonObjectives.l17-correlated-defaults: See how a shared cause makes defaults cluster in a loan portfolio.
lessonObjectives.l18-monty-hall: Solve Monty Hall by conditioning on what the host knows.
lessonObjectives.l19-bertrands-box: Count the faces, not the boxes, to find the chance the hidden side matches.
lessonObjectives.l20-two-children: See how the way you learn a fact changes the answer.
lessonObjectives.l21-tuesday-boy: Work out why a detail that sounds irrelevant moves the probability.
lessonObjectives.l22-gamblers-fallacy: Show why a run of losses does not make a win due.
lessonObjectives.l24-simpsons-paradox: Watch a trend reverse when groups are combined, and find the hidden variable.
lessonObjectives.l25-survivorship: Condition on survival and see how it inflates the average fund return.
lessonObjectives.l26-trading-signal: Decide how far a signal with a known detection rate should move your view.
